revenue_growth.source: Analyst assumption: FY2025 growth was 15.6% and FY2023-25 CAGR 8.9%; assume continued but decelerating growth on EUV/High-NA demand, fading toward the long-term rate. Not company guidance.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 EBIT margin 36.9% (12,054/32,667), FY2023 34.5%, FY2024 35.2%; modest expansion to 37.5% held flat.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2025 effective rate ~16% (pretax 12,158.7 vs net income 10,213.0); rounded up to 17% for conservatism (Dutch innovation box benefit).

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: 3-yr range 4.8%-7.8% (FY2025 4.8%, FY2024 7.3%, FY2023 7.8%); 5.5% reflects capacity expansion above FY2025 level.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 3.27% (ECB 10Y AAA par yield, 2026-11-05) + assumed levered beta ~1.2 (semiconductor-equipment-type; not looked up) x ERP 4.23% (Damodaran Netherlands, 2026-02-16) = ~8.3%; ASML has negligible net debt so WACC ≈ cost of equity; rounded to 8.5%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: ~long-run euro-area nominal GDP/inflation; below the 3.27% risk-free rate.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 4,390.9 (borrowings noncurrent 2,709.0 + current portion 1,681.9) - cash 12,916.0 - short-term investments 405.9; excludes leases; ESEF 724500Y6DUVHQD6OXN27-2025-12-31-ESEF-NL-0

diluted_shares.source: Weighted average diluted shares 388,900,000 (ifrs-full:AdjustedWeightedAverageShares), ESEF 2025-12-31 report, in millions
